# Synthetic ATS fixtures

Every payload in this directory was written for this project. Acme, Platform Engineer and the
posting identifiers are invented. Vendor hostnames model public protocols; no real vacancy,
candidate, employer account, credential or upstream test payload was copied.

The fixtures cover eight public protocols and the separate SuccessFactors legacy XML variant.
Tests mutate these examples to exercise malformed documents, incomplete descriptions, duplicate
locations, item-scoped evidence, unsafe XML, pagination caps, publication dates and cached details.
They establish parser behavior, not current live access or production host isolation.
